summary: Face detection fix: when matching newly detected faces to a photo's existing faces, boxes are now compared in relative (0-1) coordinates per face, so faces tagged in photo metadata at a different resolution are recognised as the same face; metadata faces are preferred over overlapping machine-learning faces, and the ML duplicate is then removed.

statements.why: Background face-detection job only (person.service.ts handleDetectFaces); no login, money or secret impact. Removing duplicate ML faces is a deliberate data change but not a hidden hazard.

misses.what: Fixes duplicate faces in the People view: photos whose faces were already tagged in the file's metadata (e.g. by a phone or Lightroom) will no longer get a second, machine-detected copy of the same face.

When face detection re-runs, an existing machine-detected face that overlaps a metadata face is now deleted (refreshFaces second argument), so any person assignment on that duplicate disappears in favour of the metadata face.
